# CompatibilityFallbackHandler

[Git Source](https://github.com/robotmoney/robotmoney-core/blob/58e088ac53759285525112de9eee810ef2094dce/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/handler/CompatibilityFallbackHandler.sol)

**Inherits:** [TokenCallbackHandler](/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/handler/contract.TokenCallbackHandler), [ISignatureValidator](/contracts/test/vendor/safe-1.4.1/interfaces/abstract.ISignatureValidator)

**Title:** Compatibility Fallback Handler - Provides compatibility between pre 1.3.0 and 1.3.0+ Safe contracts.

**Author:** Richard Meissner - @rmeissner

## Constants

### SAFE_MSG_TYPEHASH

```solidity

```

### SIMULATE_SELECTOR

```solidity
bytes4 internal constant SIMULATE_SELECTOR = bytes4(keccak256("simulate(address,bytes)"));
```

### SENTINEL_MODULES


## Functions

<a id="isvalidsignature-bytes-bytes"></a>

### isValidSignature

Legacy EIP-1271 signature validation method.

<i>

Implementation of ISignatureValidator (see `interfaces/ISignatureValidator.sol`)

</i>

```solidity
function isValidSignature(bytes memory _data, bytes memory _signature) public view override returns (bytes4);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| _data | `bytes` | Arbitrary length data signed on the behalf of address(msg.sender). |
| _signature | `bytes` | Signature byte array associated with _data. |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| &lt;none&gt; | `bytes4` | The EIP-1271 magic value. |

<a id="isvalidsignature-bytes32-bytes"></a>

### isValidSignature

Implementation of updated EIP-1271 signature validation method.

```solidity
function isValidSignature(bytes32 _dataHash, bytes calldata _signature) external view returns (bytes4);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| _dataHash | `bytes32` | Hash of the data signed on the behalf of address(msg.sender) |
| _signature | `bytes` | Signature byte array associated with _dataHash |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| &lt;none&gt; | `bytes4` | Updated EIP1271 magic value if signature is valid, otherwise 0x0 |

<a id="simulate-address-bytes"></a>

### simulate

<i>

Performs a delegatecall on a targetContract in the context of self.
Internally reverts execution to avoid side effects (making it static). Catches revert and returns encoded result as bytes.

</i>

<i>

Inspired by https://github.com/gnosis/util-contracts/blob/bb5fe5fb5df6d8400998094fb1b32a178a47c3a1/contracts/StorageAccessible.sol

</i>

```solidity
function simulate(address targetContract, bytes calldata calldataPayload) external returns (bytes memory response);
```

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| targetContract | `address` | Address of the contract containing the code to execute. |
| calldataPayload | `bytes` | Calldata that should be sent to the target contract (encoded method name and arguments). |

**Returns**

| Name | Type | Description |
| ---- | ---- | ----------- |
| response | `bytes` |  |
